IS 7150 : 2024 Library Catalogue and Abstract Card - Specification
ICS 35.240.30
ICS 35.240.30
MSD 05
MSD 05
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard covers the requirements and the methods of sampling and testing for the library catalogue card used for cataloguing of publications and abstract card used for bibliographical description documents, etc.
1.2 The requirements for library catalogue card and abstract card are the lame except for their dimensions.
